input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Golden Hits"?

documents.text: The Drifters' Golden Hits The Drifters' Golden Hits is a 1968 compilation album by American doo wop/R&B vocal group The Drifters. The collection of the bands' later hits charted at #22 on Billboard's "Black Albums" chart and at #122 on the "Pop Albums" chart. Music critic Robert Christgau numbers it among the essentials for a basic library of albums representing the 1960s. In 2003, "Rolling Stone" listed the album at #465 in its list of "Rolling Stone's 500 Greatest Albums of All Time".
